'''Dractuvian cave slugs''' were small, tubular creatures that lived in the caves of the planet [[Dractu]]. Although not particularly tasty, they could be eaten and were occasionally served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Description==
This species of [[Slug/Legends|slug]] was a small, pink [[Gastropod/Legends|gastropod]] that lived in dark [[Cave/Legends|caves]]. They were found in groups and had a small spherical organ on a stalk that emitted a faint pinkish glow. Within the caves, the slugs would crawl into clusters of round hollows in the walls. At times, [[Dractuvian caveworm|toothed leeches]] would also enter these stone burrows. Dractuvian cave slugs were eaten, but the dishes prepared from them were rarely described in complimentary terms, much like Dractu's cuisine as a whole.<ref name="CWA" />

==History==
{{Quote|Disgusting?! But you said it was the best thing you ate on Dractu!''"<br />"''Yeah. And have you ever eaten anything on that planet? The worst food in the galaxy!|Dexter Jettster and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="CWA" />}}
[[Dractu]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CWA" /> in the [[Mid Rim]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> was once visited by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], where he concluded that, despite the planet's «disgusting» cuisine, cooked cave slugs had the most tolerable taste of all.<ref name="CWA" />

[[File:Dractuvian_cave_slug_food.jpg|left|thumb|300px|Slug dish]]
Later, the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] also traveled to Dractu. He searched for a local cave slug, which he believed to be a delicacy. After a series of life-threatening misadventures, he found a cave filled with the creatures and placed several of them into a special container. When he returned to [[Dex's Diner/Legends|his diner]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he immediately prepared an exquisite dish from the slimy animal. Dexter dropped the slug into boiling [[Water/Legends|water]], then sliced it and arranged it on a platter with garnish. He served this culinary creation to his friend Obi-Wan Kenobi. Expecting praise, Dexter was instead baffled when Obi-Wan described the dish as disgusting, along with all food from the planet Dractu.<ref name="CWA" />

The Dractuvian cave slug was added to the menu at Dexter's Diner as a limited offering, and its availability had to be confirmed with a [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]].<ref name="DD">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>
